name: – Isabella Lövin – After § 36 – Am 5/2
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 36e. Recalls that Baltic seal populations were brought to the brink of extinction in the 1970s; points out that environmental and anthropogenic factors still pose a risk to the long-term survival of Baltic seal populations, despite their partial recovery; calls on the Commission and the Member States to uphold seal protection measures;
